notes.recommendation_vs_approval: FP16 is the recommended precision to validate first (cheapest on the device). The position fine-tune (FT-FP16, same FP16 engine cost) fixed the start-position weakness at both held-out shifts (IMPROVEMENT_DETECTED at +3 cm and -3 cm), so FT-FP16 is the candidate to validate next where start positions vary. Approval is a separate status: on hold, because every comparison against full precision is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and the fine-tune's nominal performance is undecided.
notes.simple_checks_scope: The action-MSE and audit-score thresholds were set on the same 24 normal cells, so '0 normal cells flagged' holds by construction; only the input check is independent of that set.
notes.ai_judge: Cosmos-Reason2 end-of-trial judge, held-out eval of 273 recorded trials (artifacts/cosmos_judge/eval_scores.jsonl): first setup 1/21 failures caught; validated prompt C1 p1 20/21 caught, 5/252 false alarms, 4 of them on the unseen yellow can (4/33). Wording-sensitive; end state only. Re-checked live and prospectively in the fine-tune evaluation (96 new trials, T1/T0/T2/T0R): 22/24 failures caught, 2/72 false alarms (artifacts/reports/ft_cosmos_live_judge.json; T0R in ft3_analysis).
